name: everkeep
description: Keep the repositories and packages you already own healthy: one repo by default, a saved selection, or the whole account. Triages pull requests (merges safe bot bumps past a cooldown, fixes failing ones, closes spam, escalates the rest), checks vulnerabilities, outdated dependencies and toolchains, modernization gaps and knowledge bases, and ends each run with one digest. A standard-library Python CLI gathers the facts and acts only with --apply, with every guard re-checked at the moment of acting. GitHub only for now, behind a provider interface. Evergreen.
